dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The mid-dorsal region features several prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures characterized by a dark, jagged exterior perimeter that transitions sharply into a lighter, diffuse interior. dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: There is a moderate spatial density of solid, light-gray pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, concentrated primarily along the lower lateral margins and near the base of the neck. These clusters are asymmetrical and appear as localized high-intensity nodes interspersed between the larger macro-annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest dorsal annuli form an obtuse triangle with the widest angle positioned towards the upper-right lateral edge. Connecting these centroids to the primary blob clusters near the posterior creates an elongated, irregular quadrilateral geometry spanning the length of the visible dorsal field.
